verdict.rationale: Docs confirm the free/self-hosted tier has no file limits and unlimited teams, plus full plugin/API access, supporting genuine collaboration without a paid seat (penpot-docs-9, penpot-docs-10, penpot-docs-29, penpot-docs-37). However, independent hands-on reports are mixed: several users call the editor a solid Figma-like tool usable for real projects (penpot-comm-2, penpot-comm-3, penpot-comm-9, penpot-comm-14), while others report crashes, severe lag, and performance collapse at moderate scale (penpot-comm-10, penpot-comm-15, penpot-comm-16, penpot-comm-19), which tempers the 'usable for real design work' claim. Missing for 10: consistent independent evidence of stable performance under real team workloads, and clarity on whether paid tiers unlock capabilities beyond storage that materially affect usability.
